# SD18 deterministic Human Ranger level 15 fourth-favored-enemy widening
# fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic Human Ranger level-1..level-14
# hybrid chassis (tests/sd18_ranger_level14_widening.rs, the loop's most
# recent Ranger ceiling) to Ranger level 15 as chosen input only. It names
# selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values. It is
# the level-14 fixture with the class level bumped and two additional chosen
# selections, exercising the 15th-level "4th favored enemy" interval
# (verified independently against d20pfsrd and the Archives of Nethys
# aonprd.com mirror, both byte-for-byte identical: "At 5th level and every
# five levels thereafter (10th, 15th, and 20th level), the ranger may select
# an additional favored enemy. In addition, at each such interval, the bonus
# against any one favored enemy (including the one just selected, if so
# desired) increases by +2."):
#
#   choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_4:enemy:construct
#     -- the FOURTH favored-enemy type, granted at the 15th-level interval,
#        mirroring choice:ranger_favored_enemy_3's open-ended recognition
#        idiom exactly (raw string interpolation, no restricted-list
#        validation)
#   choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target_3:enemy:fourth
#     -- the 15th-level interval's OWN bonus-increase-target choice (each
#        interval grants its own +2 increase to any one favored enemy),
#        restricted to enemy:first | enemy:second | enemy:third |
#        enemy:fourth; this fixture names the newly-selected fourth favored
#        enemy, demonstrating the "including the one just selected, if so
#        desired" clause (2 base + 2 = +4 on the fourth favored enemy)
#
# Everything else carries over from the level-14 fixture unchanged. No
# target-type matching or conditional-application engine exists in this
# codebase, so no favored-enemy bonus is ever applied to an actual skill,
# attack, or damage total; the fixture makes no such claim.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-ranger-level15-sd18-fourth-favored-enemy
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:15
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy:enemy:humanoid_orc
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_2:enemy:undead
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target:enemy:first
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_4:enemy:construct
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target_3:enemy:fourth
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style:style:archery
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat:feat:point_blank_shot
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_2:feat:manyshot
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_3:feat:shot_on_the_run
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_4:feat:improved_precise_shot
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain:terrain:forest
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_2:terrain:mountain
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_bonus_increase_target:terrain:first
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_3:terrain:swamp
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_bonus_increase_target_2:terrain:first
choice=choice:ranger_hunters_bond:form:bond
choice=choice:ranger_quarry_target:enemy:humanoid_orc
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
